name: comments-thread
title: Comments thread
description: A discussion on a record: replies one level deep, @mentions, sending with Retry, delete with Undo, and resolve.

Comment.description: One comment: an `<article tabIndex={-1}>` named "Comment by {name}, {full date}", so focus can be moved to it. The avatar (initials in a tone picked from the author's id, the agent mark for an agent), the name in medium 13px, an "Agent" Badge for an agent, `RelativeTime`, "(edited)" in text/muted, then the body in 14/21 text/default: markdown-lite, with its line breaks. With `own`, "(me)" in text/muted follows the name. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `article`.

props.name: at
props.description: When: a Date or an ISO string. Shown relative today; the full date goes into the article's name.

props.name: body
props.description: Markdown-lite (bold, italic, strikethrough, code, links, bulleted lists); line breaks are kept.

props.name: mentions
props.description: Drawn as `Mention`, with a tooltip of the avatar and full name, where the body reads "@" and the label.

props.name: edited
props.description: Shows "(edited)" after the time.

props.name: own
props.description: The current user's comment: "(me)" follows the name.

props.name: state
props.description: `sending`: the body dims and a Spinner says "Sending". `failed`: put "Not sent" and Retry in `footer`.

props.name: actions
props.description: At the end of the author's line: a `CommentActions`.

props.name: footer
props.description: Under the body: Reply, or Retry and Discard.

props.name: children
props.description: In place of the body: an edit `CommentComposer`.

props.name: animateIn
props.description: Fades in 4px up as it mounts, for a comment that arrives after the thread showed. It plays once: a later Show comments doesn't replay it.

CommentActions.description: The ⋯ menu of a comment: a tertiary icon-only Button that opens a DropdownMenu with Edit and Delete, as far as they're given. Nothing renders without either. Other props, `ref` included, go to the button.

props.name: authorName
props.description: The comment's author, for the button's name: "Actions for comment by Marta Nowak".

props.name: onEdit
props.description: Adds Edit. It moves focus itself (into the editor); the menu doesn't put it back on the button.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Adds Delete. It moves focus itself; the menu doesn't put it back on the button.

CommentComposer.description: The field and Send: a Satin Textarea (72px, resizable) with @mentions from `usePromptMentions`, and the button row under it: the formatting toolbar (Free's Toolbar, one tab stop: Bold, Italic, Code, Bulleted list, Link), `start`, then Cancel and Send. A format writes its markdown-lite marks round the selection through the field's own editing, so undo takes it back; a selection that cuts into a mention takes the whole mention. ⌘/Ctrl+B, I, E and K do the same in the field. Ctrl/⌘+Enter sends, Enter alone is a new line, Escape cancels when `onCancel` is given (after the mentions menu, which takes Enter and Escape while open). Send stays `aria-disabled` while the text is blank. Other props, `ref` included, go to the root `div`.

props.name: value
props.description: The draft, controlled: its text and mentions. The composer doesn't clear a controlled draft on submit.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The first draft, uncontrolled. It clears after each submit.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Send (or Save) and Ctrl/⌘+Enter: the text trimmed, and its mentions moved to match. Not called while it's blank.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Adds Cancel, which Escape presses too.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: The submit button's word. Defaults to Free's `send`.

props.name: mentions
props.description: @mentions: "@" opens a menu of the people `search` finds (Free's Prompt bar mentions).

props.name: label
props.description: The field's name for screen readers. Defaults to "Comment".

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Defaults to "Write a comment…".

props.name: error
props.description: Under the field, in text/destructive; the field is marked invalid.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the field when it mounts, with the caret at the end.

props.name: start
props.description: At the start of the button row, after the formatting toolbar and away from Send: the thread puts Resolve here.

props.name: comments
props.description: Every comment, roots and replies, oldest first.

props.name: currentUser
props.description: Who is writing: sends as them, and Edit and Delete show on their own comments.

props.name: onReply
props.type: (parentId: string | null, body: string, mentions: CommentMention[]) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: A new comment (`parentId` null) or a reply to a root. Return a promise to send optimistically: a dimmed row shows until the comment arrives in `comments`, and a rejection leaves it with Retry. Without `onReply` there is no composer.

props.name: onEdit
props.type: (id: string, body: string, mentions: CommentMention[]) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Adds Edit to your own comments. A rejected promise puts the old text back and reopens the editor, or shows an error toast if another editor is open.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Adds Delete to your own comments (anyone's with `moderator`). Called when the Undo toast closes without Undo, or at once if the thread unmounts or the page is left first. A rejected promise brings the comment back with an error toast. Deleting a root takes its replies with it, but `onDelete` gets the root's id only: the app deletes the replies too. Until it does, they stay hidden rather than becoming roots.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: Resolve and Reopen. A promise is optimistic; a rejection undoes the change.

props.name: resolved
props.description: Resolved, controlled: the thread folds to one line.

props.name: defaultResolved
props.description: Resolved at first, uncontrolled.

props.name: resolvedBy
props.description: Named on the resolved bar ("Resolved by Marta Nowak"). Uncontrolled, resolving sets it to `currentUser`.

props.name: resolvable
props.description: Adds Resolve to the thread and Reopen to the resolved bar.

props.name: moderator
props.description: Delete on everyone's comments, not only your own. Edit stays on your own.

props.name: mentions
props.description: @mentions in the composers: "@" opens a menu of the people `search` finds.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: no composer, menu, Reply, Resolve or Reopen.

props.name: empty
props.description: In place of the default empty state ("No comments yet").

props.name: title
props.description: A heading over the thread, "Comments", with the number of comments in a Badge next to it. It names the thread for screen readers.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: The heading's level. Defaults to `h3`.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` puts the thread on a card: bg/card, a border/default edge, radius-xl, 16px in. Defaults to `plain`.
